subject: KiteBridge tenant init: access runway & invite timeline
body:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@kitebridge.io>, Priyanka Rao <pri.y@kitebridge.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: KiteBridge tenant init: access runway & invite timeline

Hi Sam / Priyanka —

Great to kick this off. Per our call yesterday, we're lining up the initial tenant provisioning and would like to confirm a short access plan that maps to your security review and dev sprint. Below is the proposed runway and asks so we can hand off to Implementation next week.

- Short scope: one prod-like tenant in Redwood Private (VPC), one staging project in Hosted for integration testing.
- Keys: one service API key scoped for deployments (non-admin) + installer admin key for initial setup.
- Roles: dev, infra-admin, billing-viewer.
- Timeline: account seeds + invites by Aug 6; API keys and sample integration by Aug 9; first end-to-end test the week of Aug 16.

Action items for KiteBridge:
1) Confirm the two invite recipients for infra-admin (name + email).
2) Approve the attached SOW and the timeline (minor edits OK).
3) Share your preferred SSO provider (Okta / Azure / None).

Monica / Dev / Priya: please treat this as the official pre-handoff checklist. Monica — you'll be the CS owner on the kickoff call; Dev — you own the key scoping and skeleton project; Priya — manage the invite flow and role mapping.

Attachments: KiteBridge_Onboarding_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW draft), kb-invite-template.csv (sample invite list).

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134

---

From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@kitebridge.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyanka Rao <pri.y@kitebridge.io>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KiteBridge tenant init: access runway & invite timeline

Thanks Alex — quick answers inline.

On Wed, Aug 4, 2027 at 09:02 AM Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> - Short scope: one prod-like tenant in Redwood Private (VPC), one staging project in Hosted for integration testing.
> - Keys: one service API key scoped for deployments (non-admin) + installer admin key for initial setup.
> - Roles: dev, infra-admin, billing-viewer.
> - Timeline: account seeds + invites by Aug 6; API keys and sample integration by Aug 9; first end-to-end test the week of Aug 16.

We can do that.
1) Infra-admins: Sam Lee <sam.lee@kitebridge.io> and Priyanka Rao <pri.y@kitebridge.io>.
2) SOW: looks fine overall; minor billing term tweak on p2 (we'll send a single redline).
3) SSO: Okta (we'll provide metadata).

One question: for the installer admin key, do you recommend rotating it after setup or keeping for CI? We prefer rotating but want your recommendation.

—Sam
Head of Platform | KiteBridge

---

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@kitebridge.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KiteBridge tenant init: access runway & invite timeline

Sam — perfect, thanks. Short answers:
- Installer admin key: recommended to rotate after initial provisioning. Best practice is to create a short-lived installer key (7–14 days) used by the onboarding engineer, then exchange it for CI-scoped service keys. We'll include rotation steps in the handoff doc.
- Okta: thanks — we'll send the SAML metadata request and a short guide.

Monica / Dev / Priya — please prep the following before Aug 6 invite send:
• Provision the staging project in Hosted.
• Create role templates (dev / infra-admin / billing-viewer) and a starter RBAC doc.
• Draft the SSO metadata email and the install key rotation instructions (short checklist).

I'll collect the infra-admin names and confirm invites once we have the invite CSV back from Sam.

Alex

---

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: alex.martinez@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: KiteBridge tenant init: access runway & invite timeline

Thanks team — quick internal check-in thread while I assemble the handoff.

Dev — can you confirm the hosting SKU for the staging project (we agreed "standard-2" to mirror token limits)? If that's tight we'll bump to "standard-4" for safe testing.

Priya — I'll need the invite template and sample subject line for the external email. Also please save the role mapping in the shared Drive folder under KiteBridge > RBAC.

Ben — FYI: this deal is up for renewal guidance in Q4; happy to sync with you on any billing viewer constraints we should note.

I expect to assemble the handoff doc by end of day Aug 6 and then schedule the 30-min kickoff for Aug 10.

—Monica
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

---

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@kitebridge.io>, Priyanka Rao <pri.y@kitebridge.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2027 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KiteBridge tenant init: access runway & invite timeline

Sam — receiving your redline and Okta metadata now, thanks.

Update: Monica confirmed staging SKU = standard-2 (we'll monitor token throughput). Dev created the role templates and uploaded RBAC matrix here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bKiteBridgeOnboard

Next steps we're executing today (Aug 6):
- Alex: seed the tenant and mark initial installer key (expires in 10d).
- Priya: send invites to Sam & Priyanka as infra-admins and set their roles. Invite email uses subject "Welcome to Redwood — KiteBridge initial access".
- Dev: provision Hosted staging project and add sample config for CI.
- Monica: finalize handoff doc and schedule Aug 10 kickoff (30 min).

We have attached the signed SOW stub and the invite CSV (filled with the two infra-admins). Priyanka — please confirm once invites are accepted and paste the invite acceptance timestamps in this thread.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Alex Martinez
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
